question: What has Accenture reported most recently, and what is its outlook for fiscal 2027?
grading: Reference-free (no fixed answer), graded for recency and support. Expect the agent to identify the 2026-10-01 release (fiscal year ended 2026-08-31): Q4 revenue USD 18.68B (+6% USD, +7% local currency) above the guided USD 17.75B-18.40B; FY2026 revenue about USD 74.2B; FY2027 outlook revenue growth 3%-6% in local currency and GAAP diluted EPS USD 14.39-14.81. Snapshot as of 2026-10-03; later runs may have newer developments. Must cite dated sources and not present superseded (June 2026) figures as current.
answer: As of 2026-10-03 the most recent Accenture development is its fourth-quarter and full-year fiscal 2026 results released October 1, 2026 (year ended August 31, 2026): Q4 revenues USD 18.68 billion (+6% in USD, +7% in local currency), above the guided USD 17.75-18.40 billion; Q4 new bookings USD 22.17 billion; full-year revenues USD 74.2 billion (+6% USD, +5% local currency) and GAAP diluted EPS USD 13.56 (adjusted USD 13.97). Fiscal 2027 outlook: revenue growth of 3% to 6% in local currency, operating margin 15.9%-16.1%, GAAP diluted EPS USD 14.39-14.81, free cash flow USD 11.0-11.8 billion and at least USD 9.5 billion of capital return; Q1 FY2027 revenue guided to USD 18.95-19.60 billion. [T15-E1, T15-E2]
